goal: Order Drafting & Automated Stock Reservation / Locking Engine
context: Codex backend strength: develop atomic inventory soft-locking and order drafting. When a customer confirms size/color and provides contact info, temporarily reserve the SKU stock for 15 minutes to prevent overselling across 6 channels. If staff confirms deal WON, convert draft to persistent order; if abandoned or expired, release reserved inventory back to available stock.
requirements: Design schema and migrations for orders and inventory_locks tables in SQLite
Implement StockReservationManager with reserve_stock(sku, qty, timeout_minutes=15)
Calculate item subtotal, shipping fee discounts (e.g. freeship from 2 items), and final order total VND
Expose REST API endpoints /api/dashboard/orders/draft and /api/dashboard/orders/confirm in server.py
Write atomic concurrency test suite in tests/test_inventory_reservation.py
acceptance_criteria: Atomic reservation prevents double-booking; auto-releases expired locks; converts draft to final order upon closing; 100% test pass rate.
